summary: Assess process flow, yield, HACCP controls and pilot costs in agro-processing. Explore the course and its practical product-review exercises.
lede: Agro-processing training helps food-processing operators, production supervisors and product-development staff assess how agricultural materials can be turned into consistent products. Participants map process flows, calculate batch mass balance and yield, identify food-safety hazards using HACCP principles, and review packaging, shelf-life considerations and processing costs through practical worksheets and records.
audienceIntro: This training is intended for people who make or support day-to-day decisions about processing agricultural materials, product quality, food safety and production costs. It suits practitioners who need practical working tools and a structured way to assess an existing or proposed product process.
